nix_selection_mechanism.claim: Nix acquisition first tries two by-name paths, then recursively finds package.nix/default.nix/wrapper.nix in any matching identifier directory and selects head -1. It copies the selected text under the canonical directory without validating upstream program identity. This can admit namespace collisions or helper recipes.

evidence.text:
local prefix="${nixos_name:0:2}"
        local src="${NIXPKGS_REPO}/pkgs/by-name/${prefix}/${nixos_name}/package.nix"

        local method=""
        if [[ -f "$src" ]] && is_valid_file "$src"; then
            mkdir -p "$dest"
            cp "$src" "$nix_file"
            method="by-name/package.nix"
        else
            src="${NIXPKGS_REPO}/pkgs/by-name/${prefix}/${nixos_name}/default.nix"
            if [[ -f "$src" ]] && is_valid_file "$src"; then
                mkdir -p "$dest"
                cp "$src" "$nix_file"
                method="by-name/default.nix"
            else
                local found_src
                found_src=$(find "${NIXPKGS_REPO}/pkgs" \( -path "*/${nixos_name}/package.nix" -o -path "*/${nixos_name}/default.nix" -o -path "*/${nixos_name}/wrapper.nix" \) 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
                if [[ -n "$found_src" && -f "$found_src" ]] && is_valid_file "$found_src"; then
                    mkdir -p "$dest"
                    cp "$found_src" "$nix_file"
                    method="find/$(basename "$found_src")"

is_valid_file() {
    local f="$1"
    [[ ! -s "$f" ]] && return 1
    head -c 200 "$f" | grep -qi '<!DOCTYPE\|<html' && return 1
    return 0
